source: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 (definitive-period default values; corrected by (EU) 2026/1740)
note: Default embedded-emission values (tCO2e per tonne of product) keyed by CBAM good. The LEGALLY BINDING values for the definitive period are those set out in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 (with the Commission's companion Excel published for information). The figures below are transcribed to the good level and rounded for the calculator; before production use, reconcile every value against the binding Regulation/Excel (which is keyed by CN subheading and country group) and bump this dataset version. Values reflect direct embedded emissions unless a good's methodology includes indirect (electricity) emissions.
